mapper.select: SELECT ee.ENTRUST_ID, ee.ENTRUST_AMT, ee.PRICE , ee.PRICE_MODEL, ee.ENTRUST_AMT , ee.COUNTER_ID , ee.PORTFOLIO_ID , pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME , case when ep.ENTRUST_ID is not null then ee.PORTFOLIO_ID else null end as PORTFOLIO_ID_1 , case when ep.ENTRUST_ID is not null then pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME else null end as PORTFOLIO_NAME_1 , eea.PLEDGE_STOCK_ID , ee.PS , ee.ENTRUST_DATE , to_char(ee.ENTRUST_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') ENTRUST_DATE_STR, eea.TERM_TYPE , eea.TERM_DAYS , decode(eea.SETTLE_SPREED,0,'01',1,'02') SETTLE_SPREED, ep.FINPROD_ID , ep.PLEDGE_RATIO , ep.PLEDGE_NUMBER*100 PLEDGE_AMT , espr.pledStrdPrinAmt, fp.FINPROD_ABBR, MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO.NETPRICE firstNetPrice, fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, fp.regist_Org, ee.REMARK FROM ETR_ENTRUST ee LEFT JOIN ETR_ENTRUST_ADD eea ON ee.ENTRUST_ID =eea.ENTRUST_ID LEFT JOIN ETR_PLEDGE ep ON ee.ENTRUST_ID =ep.ENTRUST_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO pp ON ee.PORTFOLIO_ID =pp.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT TEMP.PORTFOLIO_ID, /*组合代码*/ TEMP.SEC_ACCT_ID, /*证券账户/通道代码*/ TEMP.FINPROD_ID, SUM(TEMP.pledStrdPrinAmt) pledStrdPrinAmt FROM ( SELECT espr.PORTFOLIO_ID, espr.SEC_ACCT_ID, espr.FINPROD_ID, CASE WHEN ppc.S_HOLDINGTYPE = #{S_002} THEN espr.AMOUNT*nvl(ppc.CAL_FLAG, 1) ELSE 0 END AS pledStrdPrinAmt FROM ETR_SEC_POSITION_RULE espr INNER JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO pp ON espr.PORTFOLIO_ID = pp.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_POSITION_CFG ppc ON espr.HODING_TYPE = ppc.HOLDINGTYPE AND ppc.S_HOLDINGTYPE =#{S_002} WHERE 1 = 1 AND espr.CDATE = to_date(#{sysDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')/*组合持仓.日期 = 平台日*/ AND espr.DATE_TYPE = 0 AND ppc.S_HOLDINGTYPE =#{S_002} ) TEMP GROUP BY TEMP.PORTFOLIO_ID, TEMP.SEC_ACCT_ID, TEMP.FINPROD_ID) espr ON ee.PORTFOLIO_ID =espr.PORTFOLIO_ID AND espr.FINPROD_ID =ep.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp ON ep.FINPROD_ID =fp.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT T2.SEC_ID, T2.LAST_PERIOD,T2.NETPRICE FROM ( SELECT tmp1.SEC_ID, tmp1.value_source, MAX(tmp1.value_date) AS value_date FROM MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO tmp1 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT tmp2 ON tmp1.sec_id = tmp2.finprod_market_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND tmp1.value_date <= to_date(#{sysDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')/*估值行情.日期 小于等于 平台日*/ AND tmp1.value_source = #{VALUATION_SOURCE_CBC} GROUP BY tmp1.sec_id, tmp1.value_source ) T1 LEFT JOIN MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO T2 ON T1.SEC_ID = T2.SEC_ID AND T1.value_source = T2.value_source AND T1.VALUE_DATE = T2.VALUE_DATE ) MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO ON fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO.SEC_ID where ee.ENTRUST_ID=#{entrustId} union all SELECT ee.ENTRUST_ID, ee.ENTRUST_AMT, ee.PRICE , ee.PRICE_MODEL, ee.ENTRUST_AMT , ee.COUNTER_ID , ee.PORTFOLIO_ID , pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME , case when ep.ENTRUST_ID is not null then ee.PORTFOLIO_ID else null end as PORTFOLIO_ID_1 , case when ep.ENTRUST_ID is not null then pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME else null end as PORTFOLIO_NAME_1 , eea.PLEDGE_STOCK_ID , ee.PS , ee.ENTRUST_DATE , to_char(ee.ENTRUST_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') ENTRUST_DATE_STR, eea.TERM_TYPE , eea.TERM_DAYS , decode(eea.SETTLE_SPREED,0,'01',1,'02') SETTLE_SPREED, ep.FINPROD_ID , ep.PLEDGE_RATIO , ep.PLEDGE_NUMBER*100 PLEDGE_AMT , espr.pledStrdPrinAmt, fp.FINPROD_ABBR, MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO.NETPRICE firstNetPrice, fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, fp.regist_Org, ee.REMARK FROM WFL_ETR_ENTRUST ee LEFT JOIN WFL_ETR_ENTRUST_ADD eea ON ee.ENTRUST_ID =eea.ENTRUST_ID LEFT JOIN WFL_ETR_PLEDGE ep ON ee.ENTRUST_ID =ep.ENTRUST_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO pp ON ee.PORTFOLIO_ID =pp.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT TEMP.PORTFOLIO_ID, /*组合代码*/ TEMP.SEC_ACCT_ID, /*证券账户/通道代码*/ TEMP.FINPROD_ID, SUM(TEMP.pledStrdPrinAmt) pledStrdPrinAmt FROM ( SELECT espr.PORTFOLIO_ID, espr.SEC_ACCT_ID, espr.FINPROD_ID, CASE WHEN ppc.S_HOLDINGTYPE = #{S_002} THEN espr.AMOUNT*nvl(ppc.CAL_FLAG, 1) ELSE 0 END AS pledStrdPrinAmt FROM ETR_SEC_POSITION_RULE espr INNER JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO pp ON espr.PORTFOLIO_ID = pp.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_POSITION_CFG ppc ON espr.HODING_TYPE = ppc.HOLDINGTYPE AND ppc.S_HOLDINGTYPE =#{S_002} WHERE 1 = 1 AND espr.CDATE = to_date(#{sysDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')/*组合持仓.日期 = 平台日*/ AND espr.DATE_TYPE = 0 AND ppc.S_HOLDINGTYPE =#{S_002} ) TEMP GROUP BY TEMP.PORTFOLIO_ID, TEMP.SEC_ACCT_ID, TEMP.FINPROD_ID) espr ON ee.PORTFOLIO_ID =espr.PORTFOLIO_ID AND espr.FINPROD_ID =ep.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp ON ep.FINPROD_ID =fp.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT T2.SEC_ID, T2.LAST_PERIOD,T2.NETPRICE FROM ( SELECT tmp1.SEC_ID, tmp1.value_source, MAX(tmp1.value_date) AS value_date FROM MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO tmp1 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT tmp2 ON tmp1.sec_id = tmp2.finprod_market_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND tmp1.value_date <= to_date(#{sysDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')/*估值行情.日期 小于等于 平台日*/ AND tmp1.value_source = #{VALUATION_SOURCE_CBC} GROUP BY tmp1.sec_id, tmp1.value_source ) T1 LEFT JOIN MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO T2 ON T1.SEC_ID = T2.SEC_ID AND T1.value_source = T2.value_source AND T1.VALUE_DATE = T2.VALUE_DATE ) MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO ON fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO.SEC_ID where ee.ENTRUST_ID=#{entrustId}

select pledStrdPrinAmt from ( select eep.PORTFOLIO_ID, eep.PLEDGE_STOCK_ID, sum(TABLE01.pledStrdPrinAmt) pledStrdPrinAmt FROM ETR_ENTRUST_PLEDGE eep LEFT JOIN (SELECT TEMP.PORTFOLIO_ID, /*组合代码*/ TEMP.PORTFOLIO_NAME, TEMP.SEC_ACCT_ID, /*证券账户/通道代码*/ TEMP.FINPROD_ID, /*组合起息日*/ TEMP.VDATE, /*分支序号*/ SUM(TEMP.pledStrdPrinAmt) pledStrdPrinAmt, /*可质押券面总额*/ SUM(TEMP.pledgeAmount) pledgeAmount /*已质押质押券面总额*/ FROM (SELECT espr.PORTFOLIO_ID, pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME, espr.SEC_ACCT_ID, espr.FINPROD_ID, pp.VDATE, CASE WHEN ppc.S_HOLDINGTYPE = #{S_002} THEN espr.AMOUNT * nvl(ppc.CAL_FLAG, 1) ELSE 0 END AS pledStrdPrinAmt, /*可质押券面总额*/ CASE WHEN espr.HODING_TYPE = #{A_012} THEN espr.AMOUNT * nvl(ppc.CAL_FLAG, 1) ELSE 0 END AS pledgeAmount /*已质押质押券面总额*/ FROM ETR_SEC_POSITION_RULE espr INNER JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO pp ON espr.PORTFOLIO_ID = pp.PORTFOLIO_ID left JOIN PTL_POSITION_CFG ppc ON espr.HODING_TYPE = ppc.HOLDINGTYPE AND ppc.S_HOLDINGTYPE = #{S_002} WHERE 1 = 1 AND espr.CDATE = to_date(#{sysDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')/*组合持仓.日期 = 平台日*/ AND espr.DATE_TYPE = 0 AND (ppc.S_HOLDINGTYPE = #{S_002} or espr.HODING_TYPE = #{A_012} )) TEMP WHERE 1 = 1 AND TEMP.VDATE <= to_date(#{sysDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND TEMP.PORTFOLIO_ID NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT TFP.PORTFOLIO_ID PORTFOLIO_ID FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL TFP WHERE (TFP.PS = 'C5' OR TFP.PS = 'C20') AND (TFP.IS_CANCEL != 'Y' OR TFP.IS_CANCEL IS NULL)) GROUP BY TEMP.PORTFOLIO_ID, TEMP.PORTFOLIO_NAME, TEMP.SEC_ACCT_ID, TEMP.FINPROD_ID, TEMP.VDATE HAVING SUM(TEMP.pledStrdPrinAmt) > 0 /*只统计可质押券面总额>0*/ ) TABLE01/*以上统计可用持仓*/ ON eep.PORTFOLIO_ID = TABLE01.PORTFOLIO_ID AND eep.FINPROD_ID = TABLE01.FINPROD_ID AND eep.SEC_ACCT_ID = TABLE01.SEC_ACCT_ID
group by eep.PORTFOLIO_ID, eep.PLEDGE_STOCK_ID) T where T.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId} and T.PLEDGE_STOCK_ID = #{pledgeStockId}
select * from ETR_SEC_STOCK where CREATE_USER = #{userId}

select fp.FINPROD_ID, case when ISSUE_TYPE != '01' then 'Y' else 'N' end IS_PPB/*是否私募债*/, IS_RIGHT/*是否含权债*/, fpa.IS_SEC_BOND, fpt.TYPE_9 Windtypeone, fpt.TYPE_10 Windtypetwo, fpt.TYPE_11 windtypethree, mRating.GRADE_RESULT mGradeResult, sRating.GRADE_RESULT secGradeResult from FIN_PRODUCT fp left join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD fpa on fpa.FINPROD_ID = fp.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt on fpt.FINPROD_ID = fp.FINPROD_ID left join (select GRADE_RESULT, O_CODE, GRADE_DATE, O_TYPE, row_number() over (partition by O_CODE order by GRADE_DATE desc) num from MST_BOND_CREDIT_RATING where O_TYPE = '01' and GRADE_DATE <= to_date(#{plateDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')) mRating on fp.ISSUER = mRating.O_CODE and mRating.num = '1' left join (select GRADE_RESULT, O_CODE, GRADE_DATE, O_TYPE, row_number() over (partition by O_CODE order by GRADE_DATE desc) num from MST_BOND_CREDIT_RATING where O_TYPE = '02' and GRADE_DATE <= to_date(#{plateDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')) sRating on fp.ISSUER = sRating.O_CODE and sRating.num = '1' where FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F01' and fp.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}

SELECT DISTINCT TABLE01.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId ,TABLE01.SEC_ACCT_ID secAcctId/*证券账户/通道代码*/ ,TABLE01.FINPROD_ID finProdId/*金融产品Id*/ ,TABLE01.BRANCH branch/*分支序号*/ ,MBCR.GRADE_RESULT gradeResult /*债项评级*/ ,FIN_PRODUCT.REGIST_ORG registOrg/*登记托管机构*/ ,NVL(fscr.SCALE,1)*100 scale/*折算比例*/ ,FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId/*市场代码*/ FROM ( SELECT TEMP.PORTFOLIO_ID ,/*组合代码*/ TEMP.PORTFOLIO_NAME ,TEMP.SEC_ACCT_ID ,/*证券账户/通道代码*/ TEMP.FINPROD_ID ,0 BRANCH ,/*分支序号*/ SUM(TEMP.pledStrdPrinAmt) pledStrdPrinAmt ,/*可质押券面总额*/ SUM(TEMP.Amount) Amount /*已质押质押券面总额*/ FROM ( SELECT espr.PORTFOLIO_ID ,pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME ,espr.SEC_ACCT_ID ,espr.FINPROD_ID ,CASE WHEN ppc.S_HOLDINGTYPE = #{S_002} THEN espr.AMOUNT*nvl(ppc.CAL_FLAG,1) ELSE 0 END AS pledStrdPrinAmt ,/*可质押券面总额*/ 0 Amount /*已质押质押券面总额*/ FROM ETR_SEC_POSITION_RULE espr INNER JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO pp ON espr.PORTFOLIO_ID = pp.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_POSITION_CFG ppc ON espr.HODING_TYPE =ppc.HOLDINGTYPE AND ppc.S_HOLDINGTYPE =#{S_002} WHERE 1 = 1 AND espr.CDATE = to_date(#{plateDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')/*组合持仓.日期 = 平台日*/ AND espr.DATE_TYPE =0 AND ppc.S_HOLDINGTYPE =#{S_002} UNION ALL SELECT pspr.PORTFOLIO_ID ,pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME ,pspr.SEC_ACCT_ID ,pspr.FINPROD_ID ,0 pledStrdPrinAmt ,/*可质押券面总额*/ Amount Amount /*券面总额*/ FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION_RULE pspr INNER JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO pp ON pspr.PORTFOLIO_ID = pp.PORTFOLIO_ID WHERE pspr.CDATE = to_date(#{plateDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')/*组合持仓.日期 = 平台日*/ AND pspr.DATE_TYPE =0 AND pspr.HODING_TYPE=#{A_001} ) TEMP LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY ON TEMP.PORTFOLIO_ID = PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY.PORTFOLIO_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY.USER_ID = #{userId} GROUP BY TEMP.PORTFOLIO_ID ,TEMP.PORTFOLIO_NAME ,TEMP.SEC_ACCT_ID ,TEMP.FINPROD_ID HAVING SUM(TEMP.pledStrdPrinAmt) > 0 /*只统计可质押券面总额>0*/ )TABLE01/*以上统计可用持仓*/ LEFT JOIN STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO ON TABLE01.SEC_ACCT_ID = STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO.SEC_ACCT_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT FIN_PRODUCT2 ON TABLE01.SEC_ACCT_ID = FIN_PRODUCT2.FINPROD_ID INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT ON FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = TABLE01.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT T2.SEC_ID ,T2.LAST_PERIOD FROM ( SELECT tmp1.SEC_ID ,tmp1.value_source ,MAX(tmp1.value_date) AS value_date FROM MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO tmp1 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT tmp2 ON tmp1.sec_id = tmp2.finprod_market_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND tmp1.value_date <= to_date(#{plateDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')/*估值行情.日期 小于等于 平台日*/ AND tmp1.value_source = (CASE WHEN tmp2.trade_market IN (#{TRADEPLACE03}, #{TRADEPLACE04}) THEN 'CSD' ELSE 'CBC' END) GROUP BY tmp1.sec_id ,tmp1.value_source ) T1 LEFT JOIN MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO T2 ON T1.SEC_ID = T2.SEC_ID AND T1.value_source = T2.value_source AND T1.VALUE_DATE = T2.VALUE_DATE ) MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO/*以上获取债券小于等于平台日的最新估值行情*/ ON FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO.SEC_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_STDSEC_CONVERSE_RADIO fscr ON fscr.FINPROD_ID = TABLE01.FINPROD_ID AND fscr.BRANCH = TABLE01.BRANCH AND fscr.VDATE <= to_date(#{plateDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND NOT EXISTS (
SELECT * FROM FIN_STDSEC_CONVERSE_RADIO fscrInner WHERE fscrInner.FINPROD_ID = fscr.FINPROD_ID AND fscrInner.BRANCH = fscr.BRANCH AND fscrInner.VDATE <= to_date(#{plateDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND fscrInner.VDATE > fscr.VDATE ) LEFT JOIN ( SELECT RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY O_CODE ORDER BY GRADE_DATE DESC,CAST(GRADE_RESULT AS DECIMAL) DESC) NUM ,O_CODE ,GRADE_RESULT FROM MST_BOND_CREDIT_RATING WHERE GRADE_DATE <= to_date(#{plateDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND GRADE_ORG_ID !='22' ) MBCR ON MBCR.O_CODE = FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_MARKET_ID AND MBCR.NUM = 1 WHERE 1=1 AND FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{FINPROD_TYPE_TG_F01} /*只获取交易场所为：01银行间，03上海证券交易所, 04深圳证券交易所*/ AND FIN_PRODUCT.TRADE_MARKET = #{TRADEPLACE01} and TABLE01.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} and TABLE01.PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId}
